title: Anthropic ends its first week at $88.91 after opening above $111
summary: Two investors could have bought Anthropic on its first day and ended Friday with very different returns.
author: Zaki News
body:
Anthropic shares closed Friday, November 20, at $88.91. That left the AI developer above its $83 offering price, even after a sharp reversal from Thursday’s opening trade of $111.50. The stock had finished its first session at $97.17.

## One IPO, two entry prices

Some investors received shares in the offering before public trading began. Someone allocated ten shares at $83 paid $830. Those shares were worth $889.10 at Friday’s close, a gain of $59.10 before costs. A buyer who picked up the same ten shares at Thursday’s opening price paid $1,115 and ended Friday down $225.90.

That gap explains how headlines about a successful offering and losses for early buyers can both describe the same debut. The offering price measures the terms on which the company sold shares. The opening price records what buyers and sellers agreed once those shares began trading on Nasdaq.

title: Saamiga Anthropic oo usbuuciisii koowaad ku xiray $88.91
summary: Maalgashadihii saamiga ku helay qiimaha IPO-ga iyo kii iibsaday markii Nasdaq furmay waxay Jimcihii heleen natiijooyin kala duwan.
author: Zaki News
body:
Saamiga shirkadda sirdoonka macmalka ah ee Anthropic ayaa Jimcihii, 20 Nofeembar, ku xiray $88.91. Shirkaddu saamiga waxay markii hore ku bixisay $83. Markii ganacsigu Nasdaq ka billowday Khamiistii, iibkii ugu horreeyay wuxuu ku dhacay $111.50. Isla maalintaas saamigu wuxuu ku xiray $97.17.

## Farqiga uu sameeyay waqtiga iibsigu

Qofkii qoondada IPO-ga ka helay toban saami wuxuu bixiyay $830. Jimcihii waxay u joogeen $889.10, faa’iido dhan $59.10 ka hor khidmadaha. Qofkii isla tobankaas saami iibsaday markii suuqu furmay wuxuu bixiyay $1,115. Jimcihii qiimahoodu wuxuu ka yaraa lacagtii uu bixiyay $225.90.

Sidaas darteed, marka aad akhrido in saamigu kor u kacay tan iyo IPO-ga, eeg qiimaha laga soo bilaabay xisaabta. Qiimihii shirkaddu ku bixisay saamiyada iyo kii ay dadweynuhu suuqa ka heleen waxaa u dhexeeyay $28.50 saamigiiba.

title: Gold approaches $3,500 as selling spreads beyond stocks
summary: Gold touched $3,503.49 an ounce on Friday. Silver suffered a steeper percentage loss.
author: Zaki News
body:
Gold came within $3.49 of the $3,500 mark on November 20. By 5:30 p.m. New York time, Corgano put the metal at $3,534.42 a troy ounce, down 2.45% from the previous New York reference close. A buyer checking the evening quote would have seen a price about $31 above the day’s low.

## Why gold and equities fell together

Kitco reported that expectations of further Federal Reserve rate increases weighed on precious metals as technology shares sold off. Gold pays no interest. When investors expect cash or short-term debt to offer higher returns, holding bullion can become less attractive. That helps explain the pressure, though a daily price series cannot identify any one seller’s motive.

Silver added perspective. At the same evening observation it was $41.20 an ounce, down 3.81%. Both metals lost ground, but the percentage decline in silver was more than a full point larger.

title: Bitcoin slips below $60,000 in Friday trading
summary: An evening market reading put BTC at $59,011 after a decline of nearly 5% over 24 hours.
author: Zaki News
body:
Bitcoin was trading around $62,000 in Amber Markets’ early report on November 20. By 5:30 p.m. in New York, Corgano recorded $59,011 per coin. The evening reading put Bitcoin $989 below the round number that traders had been watching.

## Two ways to measure the fall

Measured from 7 a.m. in New York, Bitcoin lost $2,720 by the evening reading. Measured over the full 24 hours ending at that same moment, it lost $3,085, or 4.97%. The ending price is identical in both calculations. The difference comes from where Bitcoin traded at the start of each window.

For readers following the move over the weekend, the timestamp matters as much as the headline. Bitcoin keeps trading after the US stock market closes. Friday’s $59,011 is a dated observation that can be compared with a later quote, even if the live price has already crossed $60,000 again.

title: Nasdaq drops 5.28% as chip shares lead Wall Street lower
summary: The sell-off reached all three major US indexes. The technology-heavy Nasdaq took the largest hit.
author: Zaki News
body:
The Nasdaq Composite lost 1,261.47 points on Friday, November 20, closing at 22,617.73. The S&P 500 fell 3.70% to 6,910.42, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average shed 1.93% to finish at 48,147.33, according to Reuters’ closing report.

## Where the damage was concentrated

The Philadelphia semiconductor index lost about 11% on Friday, roughly twice the Nasdaq’s percentage decline. Chipmakers’ larger losses help explain why the three headline indexes tell different stories about the same trading day. An investor tracking the Dow experienced a much smaller benchmark decline than one tracking the Nasdaq.

Friday also marked the S&P 500’s seventh consecutive down session. By the close, both the Dow and the S&P stood more than 10% below their respective record closing highs. That is the drawdown traders call a correction. The 10% figure measures the accumulated loss since each peak, while Friday’s daily figures measure just one session.

title: British retail sales rebound as shoppers stock up on pantry staples
summary: October sales volumes rose 0.7%. Supermarkets reported stronger demand for tinned food and long-life milk.
author: Zaki News
body:
Shoppers in Great Britain bought more goods in October, reversing a September decline. The Office for National Statistics published its first October estimate on November 20. Sales volumes rose 0.7% from the previous month, with food retailers reporting stronger purchases of products that households can store.

## What went into the shopping basket

Supermarkets told the ONS that customers bought more canned goods and long-life milk following government advice. Clothing shops and art galleries also reported gains. The volume measure adjusts for changes in prices, so a higher reading means people bought a greater quantity of goods.

The monthly picture is uneven. September’s fall was revised to 0.6%, compared with an initial estimate of 0.4%. Looking across three months smooths some of those swings. Volumes in August through October rose 0.4% compared with May through July. That distinction matters when interpreting stocking up: buying extra tins this month can bring forward purchases a household would otherwise have made next month.

title: Iibka dukaamada Britain oo soo kabtay iyadoo qoysasku kaydsadeen raashin

body:
Macaamiisha Great Britain waxay Oktoobar iibsadeen badeecooyin ka badan kuwii Sebtembar. Xafiiska Tirakoobka Qaranka ee ONS ayaa 20 Nofeembar soo saaray qiyaastiisii koowaad ee bisha. Tirada badeecadaha la iibsaday waxay bishii hore ka korortay 0.7%, kaddib hoos u dhac Sebtembar dhacay.

## Maxay qoysasku soo iibsadeen?

Suuqyada waaweyn ayaa ONS u sheegay in dadku kordhiyeen iibsiga cuntada qasacadaysan iyo caanaha muddo dheer la kaydin karo, kaddib talo ay dowladdu bixisay. Dukaamada dharka iyo goobaha farshaxanka lagu iibiyo iyaguna koror ayay sheegeen. Cabbirkani wuxuu tixgeliyaa isbeddelka qiimaha si loo ogaado tirada badeecadaha dhab ahaan la iibsaday.

ONS waxay sidoo kale dib u saxday qiyaastii Sebtembar. Hoos u dhacii markii hore lagu sheegay 0.4% wuxuu noqday 0.6%. Marka saddex bilood la isu geeyo, iibka Agoosto ilaa Oktoobar wuxuu 0.4% ka sarreeyay kii May ilaa Luulyo. Qoys maanta raashin badan kaydsaday waxaa dhici karta in uu bisha soo socota wax ka yar soo iibsado. Sidaas awgeed xogta dhowr bilood ayaa sawir ka buuxa bixinaysa.

title: What to look for in the ECB’s November 26 meeting account
summary: Thursday’s release will explain the discussion behind the October decision on euro-area monetary policy.
author: Zaki News
body:
The European Central Bank is scheduled to publish its account of the October 28–29 Governing Council meeting on November 26. The decision itself was announced on October 29. Thursday’s document gives readers a second look at how policymakers reached it.

## How to read the two documents together

Start with the October statement to see what the Council decided. Then look in the account for the evidence members weighed: did they put more emphasis on recent prices or on the outlook for inflation? A risk discussed in October and a commitment to change interest rates at the next meeting are two different things. The date on the account tells you when it became public; the meeting dates tell you which information policymakers had at the time.

title: How Ethereum checks a batch of payments with one proof
summary: A ZK-rollup processes transfers together and sends Ethereum a compact proof of the resulting balances.
author: Zaki News
body:
Imagine three people sending tokens to each other. Each transfer changes at least two balances. A ZK-rollup can calculate the transfers outside Ethereum’s main chain, group them into a batch and submit the result with a cryptographic proof.

## What the proof establishes

A verifier contract on Ethereum checks the proof against the rules for updating balances. For example, a transfer cannot spend more tokens than the sender holds. If the proposed result breaks those rules, it cannot pass that check with a valid proof.

Batching spreads the cost of verification across multiple transfers. Users still have fees, and the final cost depends partly on how much data the rollup must publish to Ethereum. The practical difference is that the main chain can verify the batch without redoing every calculation.

title: Sidee Ethereum hal caddeyn ugu hubiyaa wareejinno badan?
summary: ZK-rollup wuxuu isku daraa wareejinno badan, dabadeedna Ethereum ayuu u diraa caddeyn muujinaysa in xisaabtu sax tahay.
author: Zaki News
body:
Bal qiyaas saddex qof oo isu diraya tokenno. Wareejin kasta waxay beddeshaa ugu yaraan laba haraaga xisaabeed. Habka ZK-rollup wuxuu wareejinnada ku xisaabiyaa meel ka baxsan shabakadda weyn ee Ethereum, kaddibna natiijada ayuu u diraa shabakadda isagoo raacinaya caddeyn xisaabeed.

## Maxay caddeyntu xaqiijisaa?

Barnaamij ku shaqeeya Ethereum ayaa hubiya in haraagyada cusub ay waafaqsan yihiin xeerarka. Tusaale ahaan, qofku ma diri karo tokenno ka badan inta uu haysto. Natiijo jebinaysa xeerkaas ma heli karto caddeyn sax ah oo ka gudubta hubinta.

Kharashka hubinta waxaa wadaaga wareejinnada la isku geeyey. Isticmaaluhu weli khidmad ayuu bixiyaa, waxaana qiimaheeda saameeya inta xog ee lagu daabacayo Ethereum. Faa’iidada ayaa ah in shabakadda weyn ay hubin karto natiijada iyada oo aan dib u samayn xisaab kasta.

title: How to check a crypto platform’s EU authorisation
summary: The EU securities regulator points customers to its MiCA register to verify the company behind a trading app.
author: Zaki News
body:
When a crypto platform says it is authorised in the European Union, the first detail to check is the legal name of the company serving you. A brand on an app can be shared by several companies. The terms of service or account agreement should identify which one holds your account.

## What to compare

The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) directs customers to its MiCA register to verify a provider’s authorisation. Search for the legal entity and compare its details and authorised services with those offered to you. If the names differ, ask the provider to identify the relevant entry before relying on its claim.

The register answers a specific question about a service provider. It does not establish that a token listed by that provider is safe or that its price will hold.

## Sources

title: Sidee loo hubiyaa ruqsadda shirkad crypto oo Yurub ka shaqaysa?
summary: Hay’adda ESMA waxay macaamiisha u tilmaamaysaa diiwaanka MiCA si ay u hubiyaan shirkadda maamusha akoonkooda.
author: Zaki News
body:
Marka madal crypto sheegato inay ruqsad ku leedahay Midowga Yurub, ka bilow magaca sharciyeed ee shirkadda aad heshiiska la gashay. Magaca ku qoran app-ka waxaa wada isticmaali kara shirkado kala duwan. Ka eeg heshiiska akoonka ama shuruudaha adeegga shirkadda adiga kuu adeegta.

## Maxaa la isbarbardhigayaa?

Hay’adda Yurub ee kormeerta suuqyada maaliyadda (ESMA) waxay macaamiisha u tilmaamaysaa diiwaanka MiCA. Raadi magaca shirkadda, dabadeed isbarbardhig faahfaahinteeda iyo adeegyada ay ruqsadda u haysato iyo kuwa laguu soo bandhigay. Haddii magacyadu kala duwan yihiin, weydii shirkadda inay ku tusto halka ay diiwaanka kaga jirto.

Diiwaanku wuxuu ka jawaabaa su’aal ku saabsan ruqsadda adeeg-bixiyaha. Ruqsaddu ma dammaanadqaaddo in token kasta oo madashu iibiso uu ammaan yahay ama in qiimihiisu joogto ahaan doono.

title: Bitcoin rebounds from $55,500 to $63,380
summary: Bitcoin recovered nearly $7,900 from its weekend low.
author: Zaki News
body:
Bitcoin rose to $63,380 during US trading on Monday after touching roughly $55,500 on Saturday, its lowest level in more than two years.

Spot bitcoin funds provide another measure of demand. Nearly $3 billion had left those ETFs in November, according to CoinDesk. Investors are watching whether the rebound in price brings buyers back to the funds.

## Measuring the bounce

From Saturday’s low to Monday’s reported price, Bitcoin gained about 14.2%. The starting point matters. A reader who saw a smaller 24-hour percentage on a trading screen could still be looking at the same rally. A rolling daily return uses the price exactly one day earlier, while the weekend comparison starts at the lowest trade reported on Saturday.

ETF flows answer a different question. The nearly $3 billion figure covers money leaving funds over several weeks. Monday’s price records a moment in trading. One way to follow the recovery is to compare each trading day’s net ETF deposits or withdrawals with the price move over that same day. That would show whether demand through those funds strengthened alongside the rebound.

title: Bitcoin oo ka soo kacay $55,500, mar kalena dhaafay $63,000
summary: Bitcoin wuxuu ku dhowaad $7,900 ka soo kacay halkii uu Sabtidii joogay.
author: Zaki News
body:
Bitcoin ayaa Isniintii ka soo kabtay hoos u dhacii dhammaadka toddobaadka. Sabtidii, qiimuhu wuxuu gaaray ku dhowaad $55,500, heerkii ugu hooseeyay in ka badan laba sano. Isniintii, intii uu socday ganacsiga Maraykanku, Bitcoin wuxuu gaaray $63,380.

Waxa hadda indhaha lagu hayaa lacagta gasha ama ka baxda sanduuqyada Maraykanka ee Bitcoin si toos ah u haysta. Sida ay sheegtay CoinDesk, intii lagu jiray Nofeembar waxaa sanduuqyadan ka baxay ku dhowaad $3 bilyan. Maalgashadayaashu waxay eegayaan in soo kabashada qiimuhu ay iibsadayaasha dib ugu soo celin doonto sanduuqyadan.

## Sidee loo cabbiraa soo kabashada?

Marka laga soo xisaabiyo qiimihii ugu hooseeyay Sabtidii, kororku wuxuu ahaa qiyaastii 14.2%. Haddii aad isla maalintaas shaashadda suuqa ku aragtay boqolkiiba intaas ka yar, eeg saacadda xisaabtu ka bilaabatay. Isbeddelka 24-ka saac wuxuu ku salaysan yahay qiimihii jiray maalin ka hor, halka 14.2% laga soo tiriyay hooskii Sabtida.

Lacagta ka baxday sanduuqyada Bitcoin waxay iftiiminaysaa dhinac kale. Ku dhowaad $3 bilyan ayaa ka baxay muddo toddobaadyo ah, halka $63,380 uu ahaa qiime la arkay xilli gaar ah Isniintii. title: Nvidia shares surge as Jensen Huang returns as CEO

Nvidia’s chips and CoreWeave’s computing services sit at different points in the same business. A company building an AI model can rent computing capacity from a provider that has invested in chips. That connection helps explain why investors watching Nvidia’s leadership announcement were also watching the companies that buy and operate its hardware.

The size of the moves varied sharply. For every $100 of Nvidia shares held before a 32.2% rise, the quoted value reached about $132.20. The equivalent move in CoreWeave took $100 to $121.50. title: CrowdStrike agrees to acquire Zscaler in $43.9 billion deal
summary: The two cybersecurity companies announced an all-stock agreement on Monday.
author: Zaki News
body:
The boards of CrowdStrike and Zscaler approved an agreement that values Zscaler at approximately $43.9 billion on an enterprise-value basis, using CrowdStrike’s November 20 closing share price.

If the deal closes, CrowdStrike plans to bring Zscaler’s network security services to Falcon. Zscaler shares rose 15.3% while CrowdStrike fell 10.5% during Monday trading. The dollar value of the share consideration can move with CrowdStrike’s stock.

## What shareholders are being offered

An all-stock agreement ties the value of the offer to the buyer’s shares. Consider a simplified example: a package of shares worth $100 at announcement would be worth $90 after a 10% drop in the buyer’s price, assuming the number of shares stays fixed. That is why the companies identified November 20 as the reference date for their valuation.

The announcement also gives customers a concrete question to follow. CrowdStrike says it wants Zscaler’s network security services inside Falcon. For a business already using both services, the practical test will be which tools its security team can manage together after completion. Board approval establishes that the directors support the agreement. The announcement describes integration as a future step.

title: NKP leads Ethereum Smart Money inflows, nearly four times TAC’s total
summary: Only three of the five highest-ranked tokens had positive net flows in Nansen’s 24-hour reading.
author: Zaki News
body:
NKP accounted for about 76% of the combined net inflow among the three tokens with positive readings. At 09:23 UTC on November 24, Nansen’s rolling 24-hour Ethereum ranking showed roughly $6,893 flowing into NKP on balance, followed by TAC at $1,723 and REKT at $501.

## Where the ranking turns flat

CFG and HASHAI rounded out the five results returned, both at $0 net. A zero balance can reflect offsetting flows or no activity. It gives no basis for calling either token a net purchase.

The figures measure flows associated with wallets Nansen labels Smart Money on Ethereum. The roughly $9,117 combined inflow across the three leaders measures dollar movement. It does not establish how many wallets participated or whether the tokens rose in price.

## How concentrated was the flow?

TAC and REKT together attracted roughly $2,224 on balance. NKP alone took in about $4,669 more than those two combined. That gap explains why the headline focuses on one token even though the query asked for five. It also puts the scale in perspective: leading this particular group required less than $7,000 of net inflow during the period.

The ranking is a snapshot of a rolling window. An inflow can drop out of tomorrow’s calculation simply because it is more than 24 hours old, even if the wallet still holds the tokens. To see whether interest persists, a useful follow-up is to compare the next window at the same UTC hour and examine individual trades for evidence of repeat activity.

title: Coin iyo token maxay ku kala duwan yihiin?
summary: Laba lacagood ayaa hal boorso ku wada jiri kara, mid walbana shaqo gaar ah ayay qaban kartaa. ETH iyo token ku shaqeeya Ethereum ayaa tusaale kuu ah.

## Lacagta ay shabakaddu leedahay

Bitcoin wuxuu leeyahay BTC, Ethereum-na wuxuu leeyahay ETH. Haddii aad BTC ku dirto shabakadda Bitcoin, khidmaddu waxay ku baxdaa BTC. Ethereum marka aad isticmaasho, shaqada ay shabakaddu qabato waxaa lagu cabbiraa gas, kharashkeedana waxaa lagu bixiyaa ETH.

## Halkee ayuu token-ku ka yimaadaa?

Ethereum gudaheeda waxaad ku abuuri kartaa token adigoo adeegsanaya qandaraas caqli leh, oo ah barnaamij ku shaqeeya shabakadda. Heerka ERC-20 wuxuu qeexaa sida barnaamijyadu u weydiin karaan haraaga qofka ama u codsan karaan wareejin. Cinwaanka qandaraaska iyo shabakadda ayaa kuu sheegaya token-ka aad eegayso. Laba token ayaa yeelan kara isku magac ama isku sumad.

## Tusaale boorso

Sahra waxay boorsadeeda Ethereum ku haysataa 30 token, haraageeda ETH-na waa eber. Waxay arki kartaa dhammaan 30-ka token. Haddii ay rabto inay 5 token ku dirto macaamil caadi ah oo ay iyadu khidmaddiisa bixinayso, waxay u baahan tahay ETH ay kharashka shabakadda ku daboosho. Kahor dirista, waxay hubisaa shabakadda, cinwaanka qandaraaska iyo qiyaasta khidmadda ee boorsadu muujiso.

## Sidee loo kala gartaa laba token oo isku magac ah?

Boorsadaada waxaa ka soo muuqday laba token oo isku summad ah. Fur xogta mid kasta oo qor shabakadda iyo cinwaanka qandaraaska. Barbar dhig cinwaanka ku qoran dukumentiga soo saaraha. Qof ayaa samayn kara token magac iyo sawir hore u jiray wata. Cinwaanka iyo shabakadda ayaa kuu kala saaraya labadaas hanti.

## Maxaa ku dhacaya khidmadda?

Haddii aad 25 token dirto, qofka qaataha ahi wuxuu heli karaa 25 halka haraaga ETH ee boorsadaadu yaraado. Akhri labada isbeddel. Mid wuxuu ka dhashay wareejinta token-ka, kan kalena wuxuu ka dhashay khidmadda shabakadda.

title: What is the difference between a coin and a token?
summary: A wallet can hold two assets with different jobs. ETH and a token issued on Ethereum show how network fees and token balances fit together.
author: Zaki News
image_alt: An Ethereum medallion resting among green plants
body:
## The network’s own currency

Bitcoin has BTC and Ethereum has ETH. When you send BTC on the Bitcoin network, the fee is paid in BTC. On Ethereum, the network measures computational work in gas and charges for it in ETH.

## Where a token comes from

On Ethereum, a developer can issue a token through a smart contract, a program that runs on the network. The ERC-20 standard defines how other programs can query a balance or request a transfer. To identify a particular token, check the network and the contract address. Different issuers can use the same name or ticker.

## A wallet example

Sahra has 30 tokens in her Ethereum wallet and an ETH balance of zero. She can see all 30 tokens. To send five in a regular transaction for which she pays the fee herself, she needs enough ETH to cover the network charge. Before sending, she checks the network, the token’s contract address and the fee estimate shown by her wallet.

## How do you distinguish two tokens with the same name?

Suppose two entries in a wallet share a symbol and logo. Open the asset details for each and record the network and contract address. Compare them with the address published by the issuer. Anyone can reuse a familiar name in a new token contract. The same display name can therefore point to two separate balance records.

## Reconcile a transfer

A wallet sends 25 tokens. The recipient receives 25, while the sender’s ETH balance also falls slightly. Account for those movements separately. The token contract recorded a transfer between holders. The network charged the fee payer for including and executing the transaction.

## Ku bilow aqoonsiga macaamilka

Marka boorso macaamil dirto, waxay ku tusi kartaa aqoonsi loo yaqaan transaction hash ama TxID. Ka soo guuri taariikhda macaamillada boorsada. Fur bogga xogta shabakaddaas lagu baaro, oo loo yaqaan block explorer, kadibna geli aqoonsiga raadinta. Eegista xogtan dadweynaha ah uma baahna inaad boorso ku xirto.

## Maxaa shaashadda laga akhriyaa?

Haddii aad aragto Pending, macaamilku weli wuxuu sugayaa in lagu daro baloog. Marka lagu daro, eeg lambarka baloogga iyo natiijada fulinta. Macaamil Ethereum ah oo calaamaddiisu tahay Failed wuu geli karaa baloog, khidmadna way ku bixi kartaa, iyadoo wareejintii la rabay fashilantay.

Fur macaamil hore oo token ERC-20 ah. Eeg qaybta Token Transfers oo ka akhri cinwaanka qaataha, qaddarka iyo token-ka. Dabadeed eeg Value. Halkaas waxaa ka muuqan kara 0 ETH iyadoo token-no la wareejiyey, sababtoo ah Value wuxuu cabbiraa ETH-ga asalka ah ee lala diray macaamilka. Haddii aad sugayso lacag, barbar dhig faahfaahinta wareejinta iyo cinwaankaaga oo dhan.

Haddii aad sarifle lacag u dirtay, shabakaddu way xaqiijin kartaa ka hor inta uusan sarifluhu akoonkaaga ku darin. Qor shabakadda, cinwaanka lacag-dhigista iyo tirada xaqiijimaha. Kaddib eeg shuruudaha lacag-dhigista ee adeegga. Rasiidka iyo warbixinta akoonku waxay tilmaamayaan laba marxaladood oo kala duwan.

## Sidee qof kale loogu tusaa waxa dhacay?

La wadaag lambarka macaamilka iyo magaca shabakadda. Qofka kale wuxuu si madax-bannaan u furi karaa rasiidka oo u eegi karaa qaddarka iyo cinwaanka. Furaha gaarka ah wax shaqo ah kuma laha raadinta rasiid dadweyne.

title: How to check a payment with its transaction hash
summary: Follow an Ethereum transaction from its hash to its status, recipient and transfer amount. You can practise with a public transaction.
author: Zaki News
image_alt: A hardware wallet screen displaying details of a Bitcoin transaction
body:
## Start with the transaction ID

After a wallet broadcasts a transaction, it can show a transaction hash, also called a TxID. Copy it from the wallet’s activity history. Open a block explorer for the same network and paste the hash into its search box. You can read this public record without connecting a wallet.

## Read the result

Pending means the transaction is waiting to enter a block. Once included, look for its block number and execution status. An Ethereum transaction marked Failed can appear in a block and incur a network fee even though the intended transfer did not go through.

## Try it without sending funds

Open a past ERC-20 transfer. In Token Transfers, find the recipient, amount and asset. Now check the Value field. It can show 0 ETH even when tokens moved, because it measures the native ETH sent with the transaction. If you are checking a payment, compare the transfer details with the full address you supplied.

## Why might a confirmed deposit still be missing?

An exchange can credit a customer’s account after the network has already included the payment. Record the destination address, network, amount and confirmation count. Then check the receiving service’s deposit instructions. A block explorer answers whether funds moved on-chain. The exchange’s account history answers whether it has credited its customer.

## Show someone the evidence

Share the transaction ID together with the network name. The recipient can independently open a public explorer and compare the amount and destination. A screenshot of a wallet’s Send screen captures intent. The confirmed receipt records what actually executed.

title: Ethereum Classic (ETC) iyo Ethereum (ETH) maxay ku kala duwan yihiin?

author: Zaki News

body:
## Hal taariikh oo laba waddo u kala baxday

Bishii Luulyo 2016, bulshada Ethereum waxay ku kala aragti duwanaatay sidii wax looga qaban lahaa hantidii ka baxday mashruuc la oran jiray The DAO. Qayb ka mid ah bulshada waxay qaadatay wax ka beddel suurtogeliyey in lacagihii loo raro qandaraas dadka ay khusaysay ay ka soo ceshan karaan. Qayb kale waxay sii waday taariikhdii shabakadda iyadoo aan qaadan isbeddelkaas. Silsiladdaas waxaa maanta loo yaqaan Ethereum Classic.

## Yaa soo saara baloogga xiga?

Ethereum Classic wuxuu adeegsadaa proof-of-work. Dadka qalabka wax ku qoda waxay isticmaalaan awood xisaabeed si ay ugu tartamaan soo saaridda baloog. Ethereum wuxuu sannadkii 2022 u wareegay proof-of-stake. Xaqiijiyeyaashiisu waxay dammaanad ahaan u dhigtaan ETH si ay uga qaybqaataan soo jeedinta iyo xaqiijinta baloogyada.

## Waxa ay tani uga dhigan tahay boorsadaada

Shabakadda Ethereum Classic waxaa khidmadaha lagu bixiyaa ETC. Ethereum mainnet waxaa lagu bixiyaa ETH. Haddii qof kuu soo diro cinwaan ku bilaabma 0x, muuqaalkiisa oo keliya kama garan kartid shabakadda uu qaatahu taageero. Marka hore isla xaqiiji shabakadda lagu heshiiyey. Tusaale ahaan, deebaaji ku qoran Ethereum Classic (ETC) wuxuu u baahan yahay wareejin ku socota shabakadda Ethereum Classic.

## Muxuu cinwaan isku eg kuu sheegi karaa?

Ka soo qaad in isla furahaagu maamulo cinwaan ku yaal Ethereum iyo Ethereum Classic. Cinwaanku labada dhinac wuu isku ekaan karaa, laakiin xisaabtu waxay ku jirtaa laba diiwaan. Wareejin ETC ah cinwaankaas ugu dhacday waxay ka muuqan doontaa diiwaanka Ethereum Classic. Boorsada oo Ethereum keliya ku furan waxay weli muujin kartaa haraag eber ah.

## Tijaabo aad samayn karto

Eeg shaashadda lacag-dhigista adeeg aad isticmaasho. Raadi summadda lacagta, magaca shabakadda iyo tilmaamaha xaqiijinta. Qor saddexdaas waxyaalood. Haddii aad haysato cinwaanka oo keliya, weli macluumaad ayaa kaa maqan.

title: How does Ethereum Classic (ETC) differ from Ethereum (ETH)?
summary: The chains share an early history. Learn where they split, who produces their blocks and which currency pays the fees on each network.
author: Zaki News
image_alt: Computer hardware assembled in a small cryptocurrency mining rig
body:
## One history, two paths

In July 2016, the Ethereum community disagreed over how to handle funds taken from a project called The DAO. Some participants adopted a change that moved the affected funds into a withdrawal contract for eligible holders. Others continued running the chain without that change. The latter chain became known as Ethereum Classic.

## Who produces the next block?

Ethereum Classic uses proof of work. Miners commit computing power to compete to produce a block. Ethereum moved to proof of stake in 2022. Its validators put ETH at stake to participate in proposing blocks and attesting to them.

## What this means for your wallet

Ethereum Classic charges network fees in ETC. Ethereum mainnet charges them in ETH. A receiving address starting with 0x can look the same on either network. Verify which chain the recipient supports before sending. For example, a deposit explicitly labelled Ethereum Classic (ETC) calls for a transfer on the Ethereum Classic network.

## What can an identical address tell you?

Imagine that the same key controls an address on both networks. Although the text of the address matches, its balance belongs to a particular chain. A transfer of ETC changes the Ethereum Classic ledger. A wallet looking only at Ethereum may still show a zero balance. Switching the network view changes which ledger the software reads.

## Check a deposit screen

Find the asset ticker, network name and confirmation instructions on a deposit page. Write down all three before comparing it with a wallet receipt. A matching address alone leaves open the question of which chain the receiving service monitors.

title: Waa maxay Bitcoin (BTC)?
summary: Raac lacag Bitcoin ah laga bilaabo saxiixa boorsada ilaa xaqiijinta koowaad.
author: Zaki News
body:
Bitcoin waa shabakad ay dadku lacag isugu diri karaan. BTC waa halbeegga lacagtaas. Hal BTC wuxuu u qaybsamaa 100 milyan oo satoshi. Boorsadu waxay ilaalisaa furayaasha aad ku oggolaanayso bixinta, halka shabakaddu ay diiwaangeliso lacagta la isticmaali karo.

## Maxaa dhacaya markaad lacag dirto?

Ka soo qaad in boorsadaadu leedahay hal lacag oo hore laguu soo diray oo ah 100,000 satoshi. Haddii aad dirto 30,000, khidmadduna tusaale ahaan tahay 500, macaamilku wuxuu 69,500 satoshi oo sarif ah ku soo celin karaa boorsadaada. Marka macdan-qode macaamilka ku daro baloog ay kombiyuutarrada shabakaddu aqbalaan, wuxuu helaa xaqiijintiisa koowaad.

## Maxay boorsadu u muujisaa in lacagtu sugayso?

Marka Aamina dukaan lacag siiso, boorsadeedu waxay saxiixdaa macaamilka oo u gudbisaa shabakadda. Dukaanku lacagta wuu arki karaa inta uusan macdan-qode ku darin baloog. Labada qof waxay heli karaan isla lambarka macaamilka. Lambarkaas ayay ku raaci karaan halka lacagtu marayso iyaga oo aan cidna siin furahooda gaarka ah.

## Sida loo akhriyo rasiidka

Lacagta dukaanka gaartay iyo sarifka Aamina u soo noqday waxay isu geyntoodu tahay 99,500 satoshi. Ka jar tiradaas 100,000 ee ay boorsadu isticmaashay, waxaadna helaysaa khidmad dhan 500 satoshi. Marka baloog kale lagu dul daro kii lacagta xambaarsanaa, macaamilku wuxuu helaa xaqiijinta labaad. Sidaas ayaad ku fahmi kartaa sababta haraaga boorsadu isu beddelo inta dukaanku weli sugayo.

## Yaa hindisay Bitcoin, maxaase loo sameeyey?

Sannadkii 2008, qof isticmaalayey magaca Satoshi Nakamoto ayaa sharaxay hab ay dadku lacag elektaroonig ah si toos ah isugu diri karaan. Shabakaddu waxay shaqo bilowday 2009. Su’aasha ugu adkayd waxay ahayd lacagtee la aqbalayaa haddii qof isku dayo inuu isla lacagtii laba jeer bixiyo? Saxiixu wuxuu caddeeyaa cidda oggolaatay bixinta. Diiwaanka la wadaago ayaa lagu hubiyaa in lacagtaas weli la isticmaali karo.

## Maxay macdan-qodayaashu qabtaan?

Ka soo qaad in laba macdan-qode ay isku mar ururiyaan lacag-bixinno sugaya xaqiijin. Mid walba baloog ayuu diyaariyaa, dabadeed wuxuu si isdaba joog ah u beddelaa tiro ku jirta madaxa baloogga si uu u helo hash buuxiya shuruudda shabakadda. Helidda natiijadu shaqo badan ayay qaadataa, laakiin hubinteedu way sahlan tahay. Kombiyuutarrada kale waxay sidoo kale eegaan saxiixyada iyo in lacagtu diyaar u tahay bixinta ka hor inta aysan baloogga aqbalin.

## Immisa bitcoin ayaa jiri kara?

Macdan-qodaha hela baloog la aqbalay wuxuu heli karaa khidmadaha macaamillada iyo bitcoin cusub. Marka la gaaro 210,000 oo baloog oo dheeraad ah, abaalmarinta bitcoin-ka cusub badh ayay noqotaa. Habkaas ayaa wadarta lacagta la soo saaro ugu dhoweynaya 21 milyan oo BTC. Kala-badhistu waxay saamaysaa lacagta cusub ee la bixinayo. Haddii aad boorsada ku haysatay 50,000 oo satoshi, weli intaasi ayay kuu taallaa.

## Maxaa dhacaya haddii telefoonku kaa lumo?

Jawaabtu waxay ku xiran tahay cidda haysa furayaasha. Haddii aad adigu maamusho boorsada, ereyada soo-celintu waxay kuu suurtogelin karaan inaad qalab kale ku soo ceshato. Qof kale oo ereyadaas hela isaguna lacagta wuu isticmaali karaa. Haddii aad lacagta ku hayso akoon ay shirkadi maamusho, shirkadda ayaa haysa furayaasha, iyadaana maamusha dib u helidda akoonka. Marka aad boorso dooranayso, isweydii cidda ku caawin karta haddii qalabku kaa lumo.

## Adigu isku day inaad akhrido macaamil

Fur bog lagu raaco baloogyada Bitcoin oo dooro macaamil hore loo xaqiijiyey. Raadi lambarka baloogga, lacagaha ka baxay iyo khidmadda. Mar kale eeg marka baloog cusub lagu daro shabakadda. Lambarka macaamilku sidiisii ayuu ahaanayaa, tirada xaqiijimihiisuna way kordhaysaa. Layligan waxaad samayn kartaa adigoon boorso furin ama bitcoin iibsan.

title: What is Bitcoin (BTC)?
summary: Follow a bitcoin payment from the signature in your wallet to its first confirmation.
author: Zaki News
body:
Bitcoin is a network for transferring digital money. BTC is its monetary unit, and one BTC contains 100 million satoshis. A wallet manages the keys that authorize spending. Computers on the network independently check whether a payment spends funds its sender controls.

## Where does the change go?

Suppose your wallet has a single unspent payment of 100,000 satoshis. You send 30,000 and pay an example fee of 500. The transaction can return the remaining 69,500 to an address in your own wallet. When a miner includes the transaction in a block accepted by the network, the payment receives its first confirmation.

## Why a payment shows as pending

When Amina pays a shop, her wallet signs the transaction and shares it with the network. The shop may see the payment before a miner includes it in a block. Both people can open the same transaction ID in a block explorer and follow its progress. Neither person needs the other’s private key to check the receipt.

## Read the numbers on the receipt

The two outputs in our example add up to 99,500 satoshis. Subtract that from the 100,000 satoshis spent and you can account for the 500-satoshi fee. The first confirmation tells the shop which block included the payment. When another block is built on top, the payment has two confirmations. That sequence explains why a customer can see a debit while the merchant is still waiting.

## Who created Bitcoin, and why?

In 2008, someone writing under the name Satoshi Nakamoto described a way for people to send electronic cash directly to each other. The network began running in 2009. The hard problem was deciding which payment to accept if someone tried to spend the same funds twice. A digital signature identifies who authorized a payment. Bitcoin also needs a shared transaction history so participants can check whether those funds are still available.

## What does a miner actually do?

Imagine two miners gathering pending payments at the same time. Each builds a candidate block and repeatedly changes a number in its header, looking for a hash that meets the network’s difficulty target. Finding one takes work. Checking the result takes much less. Other computers verify the block, including the signatures and spending rules, before building on it. A miner who creates an invalid payment cannot make it valid by spending more electricity.

## How many bitcoin can exist?

A valid block can pay its miner transaction fees and a subsidy of newly issued bitcoin. The subsidy halves every 210,000 blocks. That schedule brings total issuance toward 21 million BTC. A halving changes the amount of new bitcoin miners can claim. Your existing balance stays the same. You can use a fraction of a bitcoin, which is why a wallet can show a small payment in satoshis.

## What happens if you lose your phone?

The answer depends on who controls the keys. With a self-custody wallet, a recovery phrase may let you restore access on another device. Someone else who obtains that phrase can usually spend the funds too. With a custodial account, the provider controls the keys and manages account recovery. A useful first question when choosing a wallet is who could restore access if the device disappeared tomorrow.

## Try reading a transaction yourself

Open a public Bitcoin block explorer and choose a confirmed transaction. Find the block height, the outputs and the fee. Look again after a new block appears. The transaction ID stays the same while its confirmation count grows. You can do the entire exercise without creating a wallet or buying bitcoin.

title: Waa maxay Ethereum iyo ether (ETH)?
summary: Baro waxa ay kala yihiin Ethereum, ETH iyo gas markaad isticmaalayso barnaamij.
author: Zaki News
body:
Ethereum waa shabakad lagu socodsiiyo barnaamijyo loo yaqaan qandaraasyo caqli leh. Ether, oo loo soo gaabiyo ETH, waa lacagta asalka ah ee shabakadda. Gas waa cabbirka shaqada xisaabeed ee hawl u baahan tahay. Khidmadda shaqadaas waxaa shabakadda weyn ee Ethereum lagu bixiyaa ETH.

## Tusaale laga arki karo boorsada

Haddii aad saaxiib u dirayso token ku shaqeeya Ethereum, boorsadu waxay ku tusi kartaa qaddarka token-ka iyo khidmad lagu qiyaasay ETH. Labaduba waxay leeyihiin shaqooyin kala duwan. Hubi shabakadda, cinwaanka qaataha iyo khidmadda ka hor intaadan saxiixin.

## Maxaa shaqada shabakadda lacag looga bixiyaa?

Ka soo qaad in Aamina ETH u dirtay saaxiib, kaddibna barnaamij ku kala beddelatay laba token. Diristii hore waxay ahayd wareejin fudud. Kala beddelashadu waxay u baahan kartaa in dhowr qandaraas ay hubiyaan oggolaanshaha, xisaabiyaan qaddarka la helayo oo cusboonaysiiyaan haraaga. Tallaabo kasta shaqo ayay u baahan tahay. Taasi waxay sharxaysaa sida laba macaamil oo ay isku boorso daqiiqado gudahood u dirtay u isticmaali karaan gas kala duwan.

## Maxaad saxiixa ku oggolaanaysaa?

Aamina waxay barnaamij u oggolaan kartaa inuu isticmaalo ilaa toban token. Oggolaanshuhu wuu hirgeli karaa iyadoo tobankiiba weli boorsada ku jiraan. Waxa ay siisay cinwaanka la magacaabay awood uu hadhow lacagta ugu wareejiyo. Ka hor saxiixa waxay eegi kartaa nooca token-ka, cinwaanka loo fasaxayo iyo qaddarka. Rasiidka macaamilka ayay ka ogaan kartaa in oggolaanshuhu hirgalay iyo inta gas ee ku baxday.

## Waa imisa khidmadda hal macaamil?

Rasiidku wuxuu muujinayaa gas-ka la isticmaalay iyo qiimaha halkii unug. Tusaale ahaan, 21,000 oo unug oo midkiiba yahay 10 gwei waxay ku kacayaan 210,000 gwei, una dhiganta 0.00021 ETH. Boorsadu ka hor saxiixa waxay kuu qiyaasi kartaa kharash ka badan. Si aad u ogaato lacagtii dhab ahaan baxday, adeegso tirooyinka rasiidka la xaqiijiyey.

## Macaamil fashilmay ma ku kici karaa ETH?

Ka soo qaad inaad dalbatay in sarifku kuu soo celiyo ugu yaraan 100 token. Markii amarka la fulin lahaa waxaa la heli karaa 98 oo keliya. Qandaraasku wuu joojin karaa sarifka. Kombiyuutarradu shaqo ayay soo qabteen ka hor intaan la gaarin go’aankaas. Marka aad haraaga hubinayso, eeg xaaladda macaamilka iyo khidmadda labadaba.

## Isku day inaad akhrido wareejin token

Raadi macaamil token oo ku guulaystay Ethereum. Isbarbar dhig cinwaanka uu macaamilku ku socday iyo kan ku qoran diiwaanka wareejinta token-ka. Kan hore wuxuu noqon karaa qandaraaska helay amarka. Diiwaanka wareejintu wuxuu kuu muujin karaa saaxiibkaa oo helay token-nada. Labada cinwaan waxay ka jawaabayaan laba su’aalood oo hal lacag-bixin ku saabsan.

title: What are Ethereum and ether (ETH)?
summary: Learn what Ethereum runs, what ETH pays for and why a wallet displays gas.
author: Zaki News
body:
Ethereum is a blockchain that runs programs called smart contracts. Ether, abbreviated ETH, is its native currency. Gas measures the computational work required for an operation. On Ethereum mainnet, the network fee for that work is paid in ETH.

## Read a wallet preview

Imagine sending a token issued on Ethereum to a friend. Your wallet may show two amounts, the token amount you intend to send and a fee estimate in ETH. The token contract updates balances while the ETH pays for the work. Check the network, recipient and estimated fee before signing.

## Why the network charges for work

Imagine that Amina sends ETH to a friend and later uses an app to exchange two tokens. The first action can be a simple transfer. The second may call several contracts to check permission, calculate the exchange and update balances. Each step takes work. This is why two transactions submitted minutes apart can use different amounts of gas even when the same wallet sends them.

## What a signature allows

A token approval is a good example of a contract interaction. Amina might authorize an app to spend up to ten tokens. The approval can succeed while all ten tokens still appear in her wallet. It gives the named spender permission to transfer them later. Before signing, she can look for three things in the preview: the token, the spender and the amount allowed. Afterward, the transaction receipt shows whether the approval succeeded and how much gas it used.

## How much does one transaction cost?

A receipt lists gas used and an effective price per unit of gas. Imagine a transfer that uses 21,000 units at 10 gwei each. Multiplying gives 210,000 gwei, or 0.00021 ETH. A wallet may reserve room for a larger fee before you sign. To see what you actually paid, use the figures on the completed receipt.

## Can a failed transaction cost ETH?

Suppose a swap must return at least 100 tokens. By the time it executes, the pool can offer only 98. The contract can stop the swap, leaving the tokens with their original owner. Computers still performed work before reaching that condition. Look for both the failure status and the fee when reconciling your balance.

## Try reading a token transfer

Find a successful token transfer in an Ethereum explorer. Compare the transaction recipient with the recipient in the token transfer log. The first can be the token contract that received the instruction. The log can show your friend as the person who received the tokens. Those two addresses answer different questions about the same payment.

## Source

title: Waa maxay Solana (SOL)?
summary: Faham sida amarro dhowr ah loogu fulin karo hal macaamil.
author: Zaki News
body:
Solana waa blockchain ay barnaamijyadu wax ka beddelaan xog ku jirta akoonno. SOL waa lacagta asalka ah ee shabakadda. Hal SOL wuxuu ka kooban yahay hal bilyan oo lamport. Akoonka bixiya khidmadda macaamilka wuxuu u baahan yahay SOL.

## Laba amar, hal macaamil

Marka token loo dirayo qof markii ugu horreysay, boorsadu waxay isku dari kartaa laba amar. Mid ayaa qofka u abuuraya akoon uu token-ka ku hayo, midka kalena wuxuu ku wareejinayaa token-ka. Haddii amar fashilmo, isbeddelladii labada amarba dib ayaa loo celiyaa. Macaamil shabakaddu farsamaysay weli khidmad ayaa ka bixi karta.

## Raac akoonnada ay lacagtu marto

Boorsada Solana waxay hal cinwaan hoostiisa ku tusi kartaa haraagyo kala duwan. SOL wuxuu ku jiraa akoonka weyn. Haraaga token kasta waxaa lagu qoraa akoon tilmaamaya cidda leh iyo token-ka uu hayo. Laba token ayaa yeelan kara magac isku mid ah. Cinwaanka loo yaqaan mint ayaa lagu kala garan karaa labadaas token.

## Tusaale lacag-bixin koowaad

Xasan wuxuu isla token u dirayaa laba qof. Mid hore ayuu u haystay, kan kalena weligii ma helin. Macaamilka labaad waxaa ku jiri kara amar cusub oo lagu furayo akoonka qaataha iyo SOL lagu maalgelinayo akoonkaas. Lacagta akoonka loo qoondeeyey iyo khidmadda macaamilku shaqooyin kala duwan ayay leeyihiin. Marka aad furto rasiidka, amarrada siday u kala horreeyaan u akhri, eeg xaaladda macaamilka, kaddibna isbarbar dhig haraagii hore iyo kan dambe.

## Maxaa lacag-bixin la diyaariyey waqtigeeda u dhammeeya?

Macaamilka caadiga ah ee Solana wuxuu xambaarsan yahay tixraaca baloog dhow. Shabakaddu waxay aqbashaa tixraacaas muddo kooban. Haddii aad shaashadda saxiixa muddo dheer furan uga tagto, xogta lacag-bixintu way saxnaan kartaa laakiin tixraacu wuu duugoobi karaa. Boorsadu waxay diyaarin kartaa macaamil cusub. Ka hor intaadan mar labaad saxiixin, eeg xaaladda saxiixii hore.

## Haddii laba qof saxiixaan, yaa khidmadda bixiya?

Ka soo qaad barnaamij bixinaya khidmadda wareejinta. Milkiilaha token-ku wuxuu saxiixayaa fasaxa wareejinta. Akoon labaad ayaa saxiixi kara si uu SOL ugu bixiyo khidmadda. Rasiidka marka hore ka raadi cidda bixisay khidmadda, dabadeed raac haraaga token-ka. Labadan shaqo waxaa qaban kara laba akoon oo kala duwan.

## Sidee loo hubiyaa waxa barnaamijku qabtay?

Fur macaamil Solana oo la xaqiijiyey. Marka hore eeg akoonka khidmadda bixiyey, dabadeed amarrada kor ilaa hoos u akhri. Amar keliya ayaa barnaamij kale u yeeri kara si uu shaqada qayb uga qabto. Haddii aad aragto dhowr barnaamij, isbarbar dhig haraagii bilowga iyo kii dhammaadka si aad u aragto waxa akoonku helay.

title: What is Solana (SOL)?
summary: See how one Solana transaction can carry several instructions.
author: Zaki News
body:
Solana is a blockchain where programs act on data stored in accounts. SOL is the network’s native currency. One SOL contains one billion lamports. A transaction designates a fee payer, whose account needs enough SOL to cover the network fee.

## Two instructions in one transaction

When sending a token to a new recipient, a wallet can include an instruction to create the recipient’s token account and another to transfer the tokens. These instructions succeed together. If an instruction fails, its transaction’s instruction changes are rolled back, although a processed transaction can still incur a fee.

## Follow the accounts in a transfer

On Solana, a wallet can display several balances under one familiar address. The SOL balance belongs to the main account. A token balance is recorded in a token account that identifies both its owner and the particular token. Two tokens can share a display name. Their mint addresses identify which asset each token account holds.

## Work through a first payment

Suppose Hassan sends the same token to two people. One already holds it. The other has never received it. The second transaction may include an extra instruction to create the destination token account, plus SOL to fund that account. The amount set aside for the account and the transaction fee serve different purposes. In the transaction explorer, read the instructions in order, check the status and compare the token balances before and after. Those three details explain what actually moved even when the wallet shows a single Send button.

## Why does an unsigned payment expire?

A typical Solana transaction includes a recent blockhash. That reference gives the network a limited window in which to accept it. If you leave a wallet preview open for too long, its instructions may still describe the right payment while the blockhash has become too old. A wallet can rebuild the transaction with a fresh reference. Check the original signature’s status before authorizing a replacement.

## Who pays when two people sign?

Picture an app that sponsors a transfer. The token owner signs to authorize moving the tokens. A second account can act as the fee payer and sign for the SOL charged by the network. On the receipt, identify the fee payer first, then follow the token balances. The account that paid the fee and the account that sent the tokens can be different.

## How can you check what an app did?

Open a confirmed Solana transaction in an explorer. Start with the fee payer, then read the instructions from top to bottom. A single instruction can ask another program to do part of the work. If the screen shows several programs, compare the starting and ending token balances to see what the account actually received.

title: Waa maxay blockchain?
summary: Eeg sida diiwaan lacag-bixin ah loogu xiro baloogga xiga.
author: Zaki News
body:
Blockchain waa diiwaan xogtiisa loo kala ururiyo baloogyo. Baloog walba wuxuu tixraacaa kii ka horreeyey isagoo adeegsanaya hash, oo ah natiijo xisaabeed ku xiran xogta. Kombiyuutarrada shabakadda ayaa hubiya in balooggu waafaqsan yahay xeerarka ka hor inta aysan aqbalin.

## Haddii qof isku dayo inuu beddelo diiwaanka

Ka soo qaad in lacag hore loo diray laga beddelo 2 oo laga dhigo 20. Isbeddelkaas wuxuu beddelayaa hash-ka. Tixraaca ku qoran baloogga xiga markaas lama jaanqaadayo xogta la beddelay. Xiriirkaas wuxuu muujinayaa isbeddelka, halka xeerarka heshiiska shabakadda ay qeexaan taariikhda la aqbalayo.

## Yaa hubiya xeerarka?

Qiyaas in laba lacag-bixin isku mar yimaadeen, labadubana isku dayayaan inay isticmaalaan isla bitcoin. Mid walba wuxuu yeelan karaa saxiix sax ah. Kombiyuutarka hubinaya baloogga wuxuu sidoo kale eegayaa lacagtii hore loo isticmaalay. Marka lacag-bixinta koowaad ay isticmaasho lacagtaas, mida labaad mar kale kuma bixi karto isla taariikhdaas. Kala horraynta macaamilladu sidaas ayay muhiim ku noqotaa.

## Halkee ku eg tahay waxa diiwaanku caddeyn karo?

Qof wax iibiyey ayaa diiwaanka ku qoray in xirmo la geeyey. Blockchain-ku wuxuu muujin karaa goorta warkaas lagu daray iyo cinwaanka oggolaaday. In xirmadu gaartay albaabkii saxda ahaa waxay u baahan tahay qof ama qalab goobta joogay oo si sax ah u soo warrama. Markaad mashruuc akhrinayso, isweydii waxa shabakadda lafteedu hubiso iyo xogta ay cid dibadda ahi geliso.

## Maxaa loo hayaa nuqullo badan?

Maktabad ayaa diiwaanka buugaagta la amaahday u dirtay saddex laamood. Nuqulladu way caawiyaan haddii kombiyuutar xumaado. Haddii laba laamood isla buugga laba qof oo kala duwan u qoraan, waxaa loo baahan yahay xeer lagu garto diiwaanka la raacayo. Blockchain-kuna wuxuu u baahan yahay xeerar lagu hubiyo xogta iyo hab ay ka qaybgalayaashu ugu heshiiyaan kala horraynta.

## Maxaa laga ogaan karaa diiwaanka dadweynaha?

Rasiidka lacag-bixintu wuxuu muujin karaa cinwaanno, qaddar iyo waqti. Cidda cinwaanka maamusha mararka qaar way adag tahay in laga ogaado rasiidka. Haddii qof cinwaanka magaciisa la daabaco, akhristuhu wuxuu isku xiri karaa magaca iyo taariikhda lacagta. Marka aad diiwaan akhrinayso, kala qor waxa rasiidku ku tusay iyo waxa aad adigu ka soo qaadatay.

## Raac silsiladda hal baloog markiiba

Fur baloog Bitcoin oo la xaqiijiyey. Raadi lambarka baloogga iyo hash-ka baloogga ka horreeyey, dabadeed raac xiriirkaas. Lambarka balooggu hal ayuu hoos u dhacayaa. title: What is a blockchain?
summary: See how a payment record is linked to the block that follows it.
author: Zaki News
body:
A blockchain is a record organized into blocks. Each block refers to its predecessor using a hash, a value calculated from data. Network participants check proposed blocks against rules, including rules about which transactions are valid.

## What if someone edits an old payment?

Imagine changing a recorded transfer from 2 units to 20. That edit changes the block’s hash, so the reference stored in the next block no longer matches the edited history. The links make edits detectable. The network’s consensus rules determine which valid history participants follow.

## Who checks the rules?

Imagine two payments arrive together and both try to spend the same bitcoin. Each payment might carry a valid signature. A computer checking a proposed block also checks what was already spent. Once the first payment uses those funds, the second can no longer spend them in that history. Ordering matters because the answer to “is this payment valid?” depends on what came before it.

## Where the record ends

Now imagine a seller records that a parcel was delivered. A blockchain can show when that statement was included and which address authorized it. Whether the parcel reached the right doorstep is a separate question. Someone still has to observe the delivery and report it accurately. When reading about a blockchain project, ask what the network verifies directly and which facts come from a person, a sensor or another organization.

## Why keep more than one copy?

Imagine a library sends its lending records to three branches. Having three copies helps when a computer breaks, but it leaves a question if two branches record different borrowers for the same book. A blockchain also needs rules for which updates are valid and which history to follow. Replication keeps copies available. Consensus lets participants converge on an ordering.

## What can a public record reveal?

A payment record can expose addresses, amounts and timing. It may say little about who controls an address. If someone publishes an address beside their name, a reader can connect that public statement to the payment history. When interpreting an explorer, write down separately what the transaction shows and what you inferred about the people involved.

## Read a chain one link at a time

Open any confirmed Bitcoin block in a block explorer. Find its height and the hash of the previous block, then follow that link. The height falls by one. Following a transaction ID instead opens a single payment record. Try both links. One lets you move backward through history, while the other lets you inspect an entry inside a block.

## Source

[NIST](https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.IR.8202)

title: Maxay ku kala duwan yihiin Layer 1 iyo Layer 2?
summary: Isbarbar dhig lacag ku socota Ethereum iyo lacag ku socota rollup.
author: Zaki News
image_alt: Maxay ku kala duwan yihiin Layer 1 iyo Layer 2?
body:
Layer 1 (L1) waa shabakadda aasaasiga ah, sida Ethereum. Rollup waa nooc Layer 2 (L2) ah oo macaamillo badan farsameeya, kadibna xog ama caddeyn ugu gudbiya Ethereum. Wadaagga kharashku wuxuu yarayn karaa khidmadda qofkiiba. Habka xaqiijinta iyo muddada lacag kala bixiddu way ku kala duwan yihiin rollup-yada.

## Hal cinwaan, laba shabakad

Haddii lacagtaadu taallo Ethereum mainnet, cinwaankaaga oo isla qaabkiisa ku jira Arbitrum One si toos ah uguma yeelanayo haraagaas. Hubi magaca shabakadda uu qaatahu aqbalayo. Haddii aad adeegsanayso buundo, hubi shabakadaha labada dhinac, khidmadaha iyo waqtiga kala bixidda.

## Sidee lacag-bixintu u martaa labada lakab?

Laba saaxiib ayaa ETH ku haysta isla rollup. Mid ayaa kan kale lacag yar u diray. Rollup-ku wuxuu lacagtaas la farsameeyaa macaamillo kale, qofka qaadanayana si degdeg ah ayuu u arki karaa haraagiisa cusub. Rollup-ku sidoo kale xog ayuu u gudbiyaa Ethereum si natiijada loo hubin karo. Waqtiga boorsadu lacagta muujiso iyo waqtiga macaamilladaas lagu sugo Ethereum waa laba marxaladood.

## Isbarbar dhig safarka lacagta oo dhan

Dukaan ayaa aqbala lacag ku timaadda Ethereum mainnet oo keliya. Haddii aad ETH ugu dirto cinwaankiisa adigoo adeegsanaya rollup, lacagtu waxay geli kartaa shabakad uusan nidaamka dukaanku la socon. Hubi shabakadda ku qoran qaansheegta, meesha lacagtaadu hadda taallo iyo haddii aad u baahan tahay buundo. Marka aad kharashka isbarbar dhigayso, isku dar khidmadda buundada iyo tan wareejinta ugu dambaysa.

## Yaa hubiya macaamillada la isku geeyey?

Nooca optimistic rollup wuxuu oggolaanayaa in natiijo khaldan laga doodo muddo loo cayimay. Nooca validity rollup wuxuu gudbiyaa caddeyn ay shabakadda aasaasiga ahi hubin karto. Hababkaas ayaa sharxaya sababta lacag-bixinta L2 ay boorsada uga soo muuqan karto waqti ka duwan inta ay qaadato kala bixid lagu maro buundada rasmiga ah.

## Labada dhinac ka raac lacagta aad gelisay

Lacag-dhigistu waxay caadi ahaan ka bilaabataa shabakadda lacagtu ka baxayso. Qor lambarka macaamilka, qaddarka iyo shabakadda loo socdo. Bogga hawlaha buundada ka raadi dhacdada u dhiganta ee shabakadda kale. Haddii boorsadu weli ku tusayso haraagii hore, eeg magaca shabakadda ay ku furan tahay ka hor intaadan lacagta mar kale dirin.

## Hubi magaca shabakadda

Laba saaxiib ayaa isticmaala isla barnaamijka boorsada. Mid ayaa diray lambarka macaamilka. Kan kale wuxuu ka raadiyey Ethereum mainnet, waxbana kama helin. Marka hore fur rasiidka qofka diray oo akhri magaca shabakadda. Lambarka ka raadi bogga shabakaddaas. Macaamilka L2 wuu hirgeli karaa xitaa haddii lambarkiisa laga waayo marka isla lacag-bixinta laga raadiyo L1.

## Isha

[Ethereum.org](https://ethereum.org/en/layer-2/)

title: Layer 1 and Layer 2 explained
summary: Compare a payment on Ethereum mainnet with one made on a rollup.
author: Zaki News
body:
A Layer 1 is a base blockchain such as Ethereum. A rollup is a type of Layer 2 that executes many transactions together and submits data or proofs to Ethereum for settlement. Sharing that cost can lower fees per transaction. Verification methods and withdrawal times vary across rollups.

## One address, two networks

Suppose you hold ETH on Ethereum mainnet and open the same wallet address on Arbitrum One. The address can look identical while the balance differs. Check which network the recipient accepts. If you use a bridge, check the source and destination networks, the fees and the withdrawal time before you confirm.

## Follow one payment through both layers

Consider two friends who already hold ETH on the same rollup. One sends a small payment. The rollup processes it alongside other transactions and the recipient may see the updated balance quickly. The rollup also publishes information to Ethereum so that its results can be checked. What the wallet shows immediately and when the batch settles on Ethereum are two different milestones.

## Compare the whole journey

Imagine a shop accepts payment only on Ethereum mainnet. Sending ETH to its address on a rollup may give the shop a balance on a network its checkout never monitors. Before choosing a route, ask which network the invoice specifies, where your funds are now and whether a bridge is needed. When comparing costs, include the bridge and the final transfer. A cheap transfer on the destination network is only one part of that journey.

## Who checks the batch?

For an optimistic rollup, the design allows a challenge to an incorrect result during a specified period. A validity rollup submits a proof that the base chain can verify. These designs help explain why the time shown by a wallet for an L2 payment and the time needed for a withdrawal through the official bridge can differ.

## Trace a deposit in both explorers

A deposit usually starts with an action on the source chain. Record its transaction ID, the amount and the destination network. Next, use the bridge’s activity page to locate the corresponding event on the other chain. If your wallet still shows the old balance, check which network it is displaying before repeating the deposit.

## A quick network check

Two friends have the same wallet app. One sends a transaction ID and the other searches Ethereum mainnet, but the explorer finds nothing. Before assuming the payment failed, open the sender’s receipt and read the network name. Search that network’s explorer for the ID. A receipt from an L2 can be valid even when a search for the individual payment on L1 returns no result.

Rollups waxay isu geeyaan macaamillo badan, dabadeedna xog ama raad xaqiijin ah ayay ku daabacaan Ethereum. Qaar waxay oggolaadaan in natiijo khaldan laga doodo. Qaar kalena waxay soo gudbiyaan caddayn xisaabeed. Eeg halka xogta lagu kaydiyo iyo cidda wax ka beddeli karta nidaamka.

## Maxaa isbeddelaya haddii aad qiimaha xaddiddo?

Haddii xadka iibsigu yahay $10, laba token ayaa lagu heli karaa. Saddexda kale way sugi karaan haddii iibiyayaashu weli dalbanayaan $11. Marka aad rasiidka akhrinayso, isbarbar dhig tirada la dalbaday, tirada la helay iyo celceliska qiimaha.

title: How to read Bitcoin’s market cycles
summary: Price tells only part of the story. Here’s a framework for reading liquidity, leverage and sentiment together.
body:
A rising Bitcoin price can reflect a burst of demand, a thin order book, or a wave of short positions being closed. The price chart alone cannot tell you which one is driving a move. Before attaching a story to a candle, look at the market around it.

## Start with spot trading
Compare the move with trading volume across several venues. A broad rise in spot activity carries a different signal from a sharp move on one thinly traded exchange. Volume can also be unreliable, so check how each source collects and filters its data.

## Check leverage and funding
Open interest measures outstanding derivative positions. Funding rates on perpetual futures can show how traders are positioned, though the rates and formulas vary by exchange. An abrupt move that coincides with large liquidations can reflect forced orders as well as changes in demand.

## Treat cycles as a framework
Compare the same metrics over consistent time windows and record what would change your interpretation. Past price cycles can suggest questions to ask. They cannot establish a timetable for the next move.

## What would two similar rallies look like?

Imagine BTC rises 5% on two different days. On Monday, several spot markets trade twice their usual volume. On Friday, most of the extra activity appears in perpetual futures. The price chart looks similar. On Friday you have a stronger reason to examine funding rates and forced closures before attributing the rise to buyers accumulating bitcoin.

## Build a comparison you can repeat

Pick one exchange, one currency pair and one closing time. For three consecutive days, record price, spot volume and open interest from the same sources. Write a sentence about what changed and a second sentence about what you still cannot explain. The second sentence keeps a plausible story from turning into a claim the data cannot support.
author: Zaki News

title: Ethereum’s layer-2 ecosystem, explained
summary: A practical guide to rollups, settlement and what to check before moving funds across networks.
body:
Layer-2 networks process transactions outside Ethereum’s main execution layer and use Ethereum for parts of settlement or verification. The details differ by network, so the label alone tells you little about how a specific deposit or withdrawal works.

## Where rollups fit
Rollups group transactions and post data or commitments to Ethereum. Optimistic and validity rollups use different methods for verifying state changes. The data availability design and the way the system can be upgraded also matter.

## Before you bridge
Check the destination network and the token contract. Review the official withdrawal process, expected wait times and what happens if an operator goes offline. A small test transaction can confirm the route before you send a larger amount.

## Follow a withdrawal

Amina pays a friend on a rollup and later withdraws the rest to mainnet. The wallet can mark the payment complete well before the bridge lets her claim the withdrawal. Write down which action she is waiting for. A payment to another L2 user and a claim on L1 follow different paths.

## Estimate the cost of the round trip

Suppose the bridge into a network costs three dollars, an example transfer costs ten cents and the return journey costs four dollars. One visit and one transfer would cost $7.10 under those assumptions. Several transfers during the same visit share the entry and exit costs. Replace each example fee with the wallet’s estimate before comparing routes.

title: What self-custody actually requires
summary: A security checklist for recovery phrases, transaction approvals and hardware wallets.
body:
Self-custody gives you control of the keys used to authorize transactions. It also makes recovery your responsibility. Plan how you will restore access before you store funds.

## Protect recovery information
Follow the wallet manufacturer’s verified backup instructions. Keep recovery words out of chat, email and cloud notes. Verify instructions directly through the manufacturer’s official site when someone claims you must enter your recovery words.

## Read what you sign
A token approval can give an application permission to spend an asset later. Verify the network, contract and approval amount on the device where possible. Keep a tested recovery plan that someone you trust can follow if you become unable to use the wallet.

## Walk through a lost-phone scenario

Imagine your phone stops working tonight. Which wallet did you use? Where are its documented recovery instructions? Could you find the backup without the phone? Write down the recovery steps on paper and leave the secret words out of that plan. Someone reading the plan should understand the process without gaining control of the wallet.

## Read an approval as a permission

A wallet prompt may ask for permission to spend a token later. Look for the token, the spender address and the maximum allowance. Sending a small test payment checks an address and network. It does not tell you what a separate approval will allow tomorrow.

title: Why liquidity matters more than a headline price
summary: Order-book depth and spreads can change the price you actually receive when an order executes.
body:
The last price tells you where the most recent trade occurred. Order-book depth tells you how much could trade near that price at a particular moment. Both are useful, especially when comparing the same asset across exchanges.

## Look at spreads and depth
The spread is the gap between the best bid and offer. To estimate how much an order might move the market, examine the size available across several price levels. Liquidity can disappear quickly when market conditions change.

## Compare venues carefully
Quote currencies, fees and withdrawal constraints affect the price you can realize. Compare depth at the same time and in the same currency where possible. A single screenshot is a snapshot of conditions at one venue.

## Work through an order book

Imagine two tokens are offered at $10 each and the next four at $11. A market buy for five tokens takes two at $10 and three at $11. The buyer pays $53 before fees, an average of $10.60. The first displayed offer was available for only part of the order.

## What changes with a limit order?

A buy limit of $10 would allow the first two tokens to fill. The other three could remain unfilled if sellers keep asking $11. To read an execution report, compare the quantity requested, the quantity filled and the average price. Each answers a different question about the trade.

title: How to read a crypto policy update
summary: A five-minute guide to checking status, scope and dates in a regulatory announcement.
body:
Headlines often compress proposals, votes and enforcement decisions into the same language. Start with the official document and identify what action it records.

## Check its scope
Read the definitions and identify the jurisdiction, entities and activities covered. Look for exemptions and thresholds before applying a rule broadly.

## Find the effective date
Publication dates, vote dates and effective dates can differ. Keep a link to the primary document and note when it was published or last updated.

## Put three dates on a timeline

Imagine a consultation opens in March, comments close in May and the regulator publishes a final decision in September. A March story reporting public feedback cannot establish what the final rule requires. Read the document available on the date of the story and then look for later decisions or amendments.

## Write a sentence the source supports

Try completing this sentence from the original notice. The issuing authority asks a particular group to take a particular action by a particular date. If the document asks for comments, use that verb. If it sets a deadline for compliance, name the section that sets it. Keep unresolved points as questions for your next reading.
